toc.title: The Project Gutenberg eBook of The Song Celestial; Or, Bhagavad-Gîtâ (from the Mahâbhârata)

ideas.name: self-control
ideas.description: the ability to master one's own impulses and passions

ideas.name: death
ideas.description: the natural end of life, to be regarded without fear

ideas.name: truth
ideas.description: the state of a proposition being true

ideas.name: aversion
ideas.description: the wish to avoid something undesirable

ideas.name: desire
ideas.description: the wish for something to be attained

ideas.name: devotion
ideas.description: Pure, selfless dedication that transcends reward.

ideas.name: sacrifice
ideas.description: offering actions as pure devotion without personal gain

ideas.name: yoga
ideas.description: A disciplined practice that brings peace and liberation through meditation.

ideas.name: meditation
ideas.description: Focused contemplation that purifies the mind and leads to right action.

ideas.name: divine form
ideas.description: Cosmic, multifaceted manifestation of the Supreme.

ideas.name: false knowledge
ideas.description: blindly clinging to a single view, lacking cause

ideas.name: renunciation
ideas.description: the act of giving up attachment to the fruits of actions

ideas.name: sage
ideas.description: A wise recluse who remains unmoved by pleasure or pain.

ideas.name: soul
ideas.description: The eternal, indestructible essence that never ceases to be.

ideas.name: true knowledge
ideas.description: seeing the changeless life in all lives

people.name: Arjuna
people.description: Prince of India, the warrior questioning duty.

people.name: Krishna
people.description: Divine charioteer who imparts spiritual guidance.

people.name: Sanjaya
people.description: Narrator who recounts Krishna's words to Arjuna.
